==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use Ritual Lord in combat whenever they have a binding ritual available to cast and will only use binding rituals under the effect. This can result in situations where they stop using skills altogether, as they do not cast a binding ritual if the corresponding spirit is still alive in range.
** [https://imgur.com/gallery/ritual-lord-ai-bug-AcY22Mf Demonstration of AI usage]. Note at the 33 second mark the hero stops using skills due to having activated Ritual Lord with a Bloodsong still alive in spirit range.

== Notes ==
* This skill can be used while activating a Binding Ritual, since it does not have an activation time.
* Instead of causing skills to recharge faster, Ritual Lord actually reduces the recharge time of a skill by {{gr|10|60||%}}.
{{anomaly|Ritual Lord will only increase the skill progression of a skill, and not inherent effects from Spawning Power.}}

== Trivia ==
* This is the only [[unlock]]able non-signet skill that costs neither energy nor adrenaline.
* This skill has the lowest [[health]] loss of all skills indicating a [[sacrifice]] cost.
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Ritual Lord/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
